summary.en: Two days ago, some of the cyanide in the Teitan University research lab was stolen. In the present, Takagi stumbled upon a person who was holding cyanide, so he had him taken to the police station for interrogation. He then finds Conan and Kogoro walking on the street, so he comes for consultation about this particular case. Takagi mentions that the man kept looking at his watch for some reason, and that the amount of cyanide he was holding is less than the amount stolen from the lab. These two may suggest that the three still have time to prevent someone from consuming the cyanide since the target was absent when the man put the poison. The location is quickly narrowed down to buildings on their south, which is still too broad for them to find the exact target. Conan then asks Takagi for photos of the man, and one of the photos reminds Kogoro of a restaurant 500 meters away from them in the south called Namikawa. This is because the owner of the restaurant sometimes splashes nearby when she sprinkles water in front of the shop. The amount he was keeping, though was less than the stolen amount, is more than enough to kill multiple people, so we can assume the same with the stolen amount.
